column2: Secure the sector and destroy every hive
Welcome back to the green hell, Commander. The Bugs have dug in across this whole sector. You're going in with no foothold - secure that forward base first and we can start dropping reinforcements.
Base secured. Reinforcements are on the way. Now sweep this area clean - every hive, every hole. The only good Bug is a dead Bug.
First cluster of hives is ash. Outstanding work. But recon's picking up something a lot bigger deeper in the valley...
There it is - a whole second nest the eggheads were keeping under wraps. Containment's blown wide open. Get in there and burn it all down.
Sector's clean, Commander. You came in with nothing and you're walking out on a graveyard of Bugs. That's how it's done.
